It’s not too late, baby, for one more: ‘Beautiful’ at Drury Lane Oakbrook Reviews Feb 11 Written by Patrick O'Brien Drury Lane’s go at “ Beautiful ” is the latest production of the Carole King bio-musical in Chicagoland after both Marriott and Paramount had their turn.
Packed with great music from start to finish, 'Beautiful: The Carole King Musical' is a lovely celebration of one of the most successful songwriters in American history.
Most disappointing was the underwhelming 11 o'clock number that finds King in the studio recording '(You Make Me Feel Like) A Natural Woman,' which represents her claiming her power as a solo artist.
Gershman is terrific and played well with the cast of players that make up an ensemble that is top-notch.
Under the expert direction of Jane Lanier, and with great minimalist set design by Misha Kachman and terrific period costumes by Nicole Boylan this version of 'Beautiful' is a must-see.
